en: Color-tinted postcard view of a grand historic theatre building with a large green domed roof and ornate classical façade featuring columns, statues and reliefs. The front pediment bears the inscription "STADT-THEATER" and the top-left corner of the card is printed with the words "Graz Stadttheater". The scene is set on a broad street or square with some greenery and surrounding buildings, in a slightly faded, vintage style.
